paite: Huan ka dak nawn a, ngai in, laibuzial leng ka mu hi.
heading: Laibuzial Leng Muhna
english: Then again I lifted up my eyes and saw, and behold, a flying scroll.

paite: Ama'n ka kiang ah, "Bang na mu a?" hon chi hi. Ke'n, “Laibuzial leng ka mu; huai dunglam tong sawmnih ahi a, availam tong sawm," ka chi hi.
english: He said to me, “What do you see?” I answered, “I see a flying scroll; its length is twenty cubits, and its width ten cubits.”

paite: Ama'n ka kiang ah, "Hiai gam pumpi tung a paikhia hamsia ahi, huai dungzui in kuapeuh guta tu a kipan satkhiak in a-om ding ua; huai dungzui in kuapeuh dikloupi a kichiamte tu a kipan satkhiak in a-om ding uh.
english: Then he said to me, “This is the curse that goes out over the surface of the whole land, for everyone who steals shall be cut off according to it on the one side; and everyone who swears falsely shall be cut off according to it on the other side.

paite: Ka paikhesak ding, sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi a, gutami inn ah alut ding, ka min a zuau a hamsia zangmi inn ah; huan a-inn ah a-om gige dia, asing asuang toh anegai ding," achi hi.
english: I will cause it to go out,” says Yahweh of Armies, “and it will enter into the house of the thief, and into the house of him who swears falsely by my name; and it will remain in the middle of his house, and will destroy it with its timber and its stones.”

paite: Huchi in kei hon houpih angel apaikhia a, ka kiang ah, "Tu in dak inla, bang ahia paikhia chih en in," achi hi.
heading: Ephah Leh Numei Muhna
english: Then the angel who talked with me came forward and said to me, “Lift up now your eyes and see what this is that is appearing.”

paite: Ke'n, "Bang ahia?" ka chi hi. Ama'n, "Hiai a paikhia 'Ephah' ahi, achi a, huai lou in, hiai, 'Gamsung tengteng a mite khelhna ahi," " achi hi.
english: I said, “What is it?” He said, “This is the ephah basket that is appearing.” He said moreover, “This is their appearance in all the land—

paite: Ngai in, "Ngensik dopkang in a-om a; huai Ephah sung a tu hiai numei ahi," achi lai hi.
english: and behold, a lead cover weighing one talent was lifted up—and there was a woman sitting in the middle of the ephah basket.”

paite: Huan ama'n, “Hiai gitlouhna ahi," achi a; huai Ephah sung a-ensuak a; huai agong ah ngen gik angasuk hi.
english: He said, “This is Wickedness;” and he threw her down into the middle of the ephah basket; and he threw the lead weight on its mouth.

paite: Huchi in ka dak a, ngai in, numei nih hong paikhia ua, akhate uah huih a-om hi. Tuivapi bang in kha anei ua; huchi in lei leh van kikal ah huai Ephah adomtou uhi.
english: Then I lifted up my eyes and saw, and behold, there were two women; and the wind was in their wings. Now they had wings like the wings of a stork, and they lifted up the ephah basket between earth and the sky.

paite: Kei hon houpih angel kiang ah, "Hiaite'n koilam a Ephah po ding uh ahia?" ka chi hi.
english: Then I said to the angel who talked with me, “Where are these carrying the ephah basket?”

paite: Ama'n ka kiang ah, "Shinar gam a inn ding lam ding in. Huan abawl zoh chiang un ama muntak ah koih in a-om ding," achi hi.
english: He said to me, “To build her a house in the land of Shinar. When it is prepared, she will be set there in her own place.”
